quartz.rationale: The legacy adapter has explicit registered goals and no registered required goals, so its required-goal checks pass vacuously. Loaded predicate 1 derives obligations from the signed order: optional G4 cannot cover mandatory R8, and R3 and R5 are absent. Passing receipts for optional outputs do not repair required coverage.

maple.rationale: The registered required goals G4 and G2 have current passing criteria and usable readback receipts, satisfying the legacy adapter. Loaded predicate 1 uses the signed-order domain independently of the registry: mandatory R3 has no required goal, checklist, or required outcome criterion. No amendment removes that obligation.

orchid.rationale: The signed amendment replaces R5 with R6, and all current mandatory items have verified required-goal coverage. X16 addresses another order and is not binding here.

linen.rationale: All required outputs are verified. The legacy final transition passes because it does not read stop events. Loaded predicate 6 and the final-transition authority guard block publication: S81 binds this order and became durable before any notification was committed.
